activity.summary: Deferred by the owner: Ask's menus serve almost no one yet

summary: Deferred (owner, 2026-10-08). Ask on rise.syberlabs.io needs a reader-owned key (OpenRouter) that few readers will configure, and local Kev scored poorly on the evaluations, so teaching its menus the looks serves almost no one; inside ChatGPT and Claude the host’s own model already chooses the look (SCR-002). A reader TypeSafe connection is also out: TypeSafe’s API answers browsers only from its own console. Reopen when Ask sees real use, or if RISE decides to pay for inference (which reverses #294); the TypeSafe evaluation branch typesafe-direct is kept for that.
